host-cpu.query:
Perf | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Computer == "HV-HOST-01"
| where ObjectName == "Hyper-V Hypervisor Logical Processor" and CounterName == "% Total Run Time" and InstanceName == "_Total"
| summarize CPU=avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain})

wait.query:
Perf | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Computer == "HV-HOST-01"
| where ObjectName == "Hyper-V Hypervisor Virtual Processor" and CounterName == "CPU Wait Time Per Dispatch" and InstanceName contains ":"
| extend Guest=tostring(split(InstanceName,":")[0])
| summarize WaitNs=avg(CounterValue) by Guest,bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain})

wait-summary.query:
Perf | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Computer == "HV-HOST-01"
| where ObjectName == "Hyper-V Hypervisor Virtual Processor" and CounterName == "CPU Wait Time Per Dispatch" and InstanceName contains ":"
| extend Guest=tostring(split(InstanceName,":")[0])
| summarize MeanNs=round(avg(CounterValue)),P95Ns=round(percentile(CounterValue,95)),PeakNs=max(CounterValue) by Guest

cluster-cpu.query:
Perf | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Computer in ("WIN2019-GUEST","WIN2022-GUEST","WIN2025-GUEST-01")
| where ObjectName == "Processor Information" and CounterName == "% Processor Time" and InstanceName == "_Total"
| summarize MemberCPU=avg(CounterValue) by Computer,bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain})
| summarize ClusterCPU=avg(MemberCPU),BusiestMemberCPU=max(MemberCPU) by TimeGenerated

cluster-memory.query:
Perf | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Computer in ("WIN2019-GUEST","WIN2022-GUEST","WIN2025-GUEST-01")
| where ObjectName == "Memory" and CounterName == "Available Bytes"
| summarize UsedPercent=100.0*(1-avg(CounterValue)/8589934592.0) by Computer,bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain})
| summarize ClusterMemory=avg(UsedPercent),BusiestMemberMemory=max(UsedPercent) by TimeGenerated

memory-cap.query:
HvSqlMemory_CL | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize MaxMemoryMB=avg(MaxMemoryMB),CommittedMB=avg(TotalMemoryMB),ProcessMB=avg(ProcessMB) by bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain})

memory-breakdown.query:
HvSqlMemory_CL | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize FreeMB=avg(FreeMemoryMB),CacheMB=avg(CacheMemoryMB),OtherInternalMB=avg(StolenMemoryMB),NonFreeCommittedMB=avg(TotalMemoryMB-FreeMemoryMB) by bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain})

memory-headroom.query:
HvSqlMemory_CL | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize OSAvailableMB=avg(OsAvailableMB),PendingGrants=max(PendingGrants),GrantCount=max(GrantCount) by bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain})

host-storage-iops.query:
Perf | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Computer == "HV-HOST-01"
| where ObjectName == "PhysicalDisk" and CounterName in ("Disk Reads/sec","Disk Writes/sec") and InstanceName != "_Total"
| extend Series=strcat(InstanceName," / ",CounterName)
| summarize IOPS=avg(CounterValue) by Series,bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain})

host-storage-latency.query:
Perf | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Computer == "HV-HOST-01"
| where ObjectName == "PhysicalDisk" and CounterName in ("Avg. Disk sec/Read","Avg. Disk sec/Write") and InstanceName != "_Total"
| extend Series=strcat(InstanceName," / ",CounterName)
| summarize LatencyMs=avg(CounterValue)*1000 by Series,bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain})

vhdx-latency.query:
Perf | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Computer == "HV-HOST-01"
| where ObjectName == "Hyper-V Virtual Storage Device" and CounterName == "Latency" and InstanceName endswith ".vhdx"
| summarize LatencyMs=avg(CounterValue)*1000 by InstanceName,bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain})

vhdx-iops.query:
Perf | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Computer == "HV-HOST-01"
| where ObjectName == "Hyper-V Virtual Storage Device" and CounterName in ("Read Operations/Sec","Write Operations/Sec") and InstanceName endswith ".vhdx"
| extend Series=strcat(InstanceName," / ",CounterName)
| summarize IOPS=avg(CounterValue) by Series,bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain})

windows-latency.query:
Perf | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Computer != "HV-HOST-01" and ObjectName == "LogicalDisk" and CounterName == "Avg. Disk sec/Transfer" and InstanceName != "_Total"
| extend Volume=strcat(Computer," / ",InstanceName)
| summarize LatencyMs=avg(CounterValue)*1000 by Volume,bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain})

windows-iops.query:
Perf | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Computer != "HV-HOST-01" and ObjectName == "LogicalDisk" and CounterName == "Disk Transfers/sec" and InstanceName != "_Total"
| extend Volume=strcat(Computer," / ",InstanceName)
| summarize IOPS=avg(CounterValue) by Volume,bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain})

sql-counters.query:
Perf | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Computer == "SQL2019-GUEST"
| where ObjectName == "SQLServer:Memory Manager" and CounterName in ("Total Server Memory (KB)","Free Memory (KB)","Database Cache Memory (KB)","Stolen Server Memory (KB)")
| summarize MemoryMiB=avg(CounterValue)/1024 by CounterName,bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain})

arc.query:
resources | where type =~ "microsoft.hybridcompute/machines" and resourceGroup =~ "rg-hyperv-arc-monitor-demo"
| project Machine=name,Region=location,Status=tostring(properties.status),Cluster=tostring(tags.cluster),OS=tostring(properties.osSku)

heartbeat.query:
Heartbeat | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated),Samples=count() by Computer,OSType | order by Computer asc

rhel-device-iops.query: HvLinuxDisk_CL | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AccountingScope == 'block-device' | summarize ReadIOPS=avg(ReadIOPS),WriteIOPS=avg(WriteIOPS) by Device,bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain})

rhel-device-latency.query: HvLinuxDisk_CL | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AccountingScope == 'block-device' | extend ReadOps=ReadIOPS*IntervalSeconds,WriteOps=WriteIOPS*IntervalSeconds | summarize ReadOps=sum(ReadOps),WriteOps=sum(WriteOps),ReadWeighted=sum(ReadAwaitMs*ReadOps),WriteWeighted=sum(WriteAwaitMs*WriteOps) by Device,bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain}) | extend ReadLatencyMs=iff(ReadOps>0,ReadWeighted/ReadOps,real(null)),WriteLatencyMs=iff(WriteOps>0,WriteWeighted/WriteOps,real(null)) | project TimeGenerated,Device,ReadLatencyMs,WriteLatencyMs

rhel-device-detail.query: HvLinuxDisk_CL | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AccountingScope == 'block-device' | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) by Computer,Device | project Computer,Device,MountedVolumes,ReadIOPS,WriteIOPS,ReadAwaitMs,WriteAwaitMs,AvgQueueDepth,UtilizationPct

windows-guest-memory.query: let capacity=datatable(Computer:string,Bytes:real)['HV-HOST-01',68719476736.0,'SQL2019-GUEST',12884901888.0,'WIN2019-GUEST',8589934592.0,'WIN2022-GUEST',8589934592.0,'WIN2025-GUEST-01',8589934592.0]; Perf | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and ObjectName == 'Memory' and CounterName == 'Available Bytes' | summarize Available=avg(CounterValue) by Computer,bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain}) | join kind=inner capacity on Computer | project TimeGenerated,Computer,UsedPercent=100.0*(1-Available/Bytes)

rhel-guest-memory.query: Perf | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Computer == 'RHEL94-GUEST' and ObjectName == 'Memory' and CounterName == '% Used Memory' | summarize UsedPercent=avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain})

cluster-contention.query: Perf | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Computer == 'HV-HOST-01' and ObjectName == 'Hyper-V Hypervisor Virtual Processor' and CounterName == 'CPU Wait Time Per Dispatch' and InstanceName contains ':' | extend Guest=tostring(split(InstanceName,':')[0]) | where Guest in ('WIN2019-GUEST','WIN2022-GUEST','WIN2025-GUEST-01') | summarize MeanWaitNs=avg(CounterValue),P95WaitNs=percentile(CounterValue,95) by bin(TimeGenerated,{TimeRange:grain})

ct-file-changes.query: ConfigurationChange | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Computer == 'SQL2019-GUEST' | where FileSystemPath contains 'ChangeTracking-v22' | project TimeGenerated,Computer,ConfigChangeType,ChangeCategory,FileSystemPath,FieldsChanged,PreviousFileContentChecksum,FileContentChecksum | order by TimeGenerated desc

ct-sql-services.query: ConfigurationData | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Computer == 'SQL2019-GUEST' and SvcName in ('MSSQLSERVER','SQLSERVERAGENT','SqlServerExtension') | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) by SvcName | project TimeGenerated,Computer,SvcName,SvcState,SvcStartupType,SvcAccount

update-assessment.query: patchassessmentresources | where resourceGroup =~ 'rg-hyperv-arc-monitor-demo' and type contains 'softwarepatches' | extend Machine=tostring(split(id,'/')[8]) | where Machine =~ 'SQL2019-GUEST' | project Machine,Patch=tostring(properties.patchName),KB=tostring(properties.kbId),Classification=properties.classifications,RebootBehavior=tostring(properties.rebootBehavior)

update-history.query: patchinstallationresources | where resourceGroup =~ 'rg-hyperv-arc-monitor-demo' and type !contains 'softwarepatches' | extend Machine=tostring(split(id,'/')[8]) | where Machine =~ 'SQL2019-GUEST' | project Machine,Status=tostring(properties.status),Installed=toint(properties.installedPatchCount),Failed=toint(properties.failedPatchCount),Excluded=toint(properties.excludedPatchCount),RebootStatus=tostring(properties.rebootStatus),Updated=todatetime(properties.lastModifiedDateTime)
